_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. Licence policy for what Sangam ships (SANGAM.md X.3, X.3a LIC-1..LIC-11). Used by check_licences.py in CI (licence-check.yml, release.yml, ui.yml). This file records owner decisions as gate rules; it is not a legal conclusion.
_comment_allowed: SPDX ids (RM-18: no home-made ids; the old spellings EDL-1.0, Bouncy-Castle and GPL-2.0-with-classpath-exception are aliases in check_licences.py normalise()).
_comment_conditional: Allowed only for the named components (purl prefix; a prefix with @version pins one version) and only under the stated condition. Checked BEFORE forbidden_licenses (RM-18), so a scoped entry is live. allowed_in: the distribution ids (distributions.json) in which the entry applies; anywhere else the licence is forbidden.

conditional.condition: LIC-5: separate replaceable jar in /opt/sangam/lib-ext with source offer; never inside the fat jar (checked by --jar)

Lab Software License, Version 1.2 (the jar META-INF/LICENSE), BSD style. Only io.github.x-stream:mxparser 1.2.2 as an optional dependency of the HAPI FHIR validation path. Where it ships, the distribution NOTICE carries the copyright, the licence and the IU acknowledgement from attributions/mxparser-1.2.2.txt (notice_bundle.py); no endorsement and no 'Indiana University' in a product name. Its xmlpull:xmlpull 1.1.3.1 dependency is public domain (LicenseRef-Public-Domain).
LIC-8: unmodified, watermark kept visible in modeller and viewer screens

Owner decision 70 (2026-11-12): fonts only, embedded in generated PDF/A documents by the M-081 renderer. Reason: PDF/A-2b requires every font to be embedded and Devanagari text needs a font that covers it; Noto Sans Devanagari is OFL-1.1. Scope: the unmodified font file, shipped with its OFL.txt, never sold on its own and never renamed (OFL-1.1 conditions 1, 3, 4); no OFL-licensed code. Widened by owner decision 95 to Noto Sans for Latin text. Owner decisions 120 and 121: the same unmodified Noto Sans and Noto Sans Devanagari TTFs, each with its OFL text, are also served as same-origin UI web fonts from sangam-ui dist/fonts/noto/ (copied and hash-checked at build by sangam-ui scripts/deploy-fonts.mjs); no other font is served. Files and hashes in deploy/fonts/README.md. Any other OFL font needs a new owner decision.

_comment_elections: Owner decision 117 (C-02, 2026-11-12), plus decisions 90 (cryptacular), 94 (veraPDF) and 176 (the six Jersey jars of DR-01 join the EPL-2.0 entry): the licence Sangam elects for a component offered under a choice. Keyed by exact purl (pkg:type/namespace/name@version), or by purl prefix plus exact versions. The gate checks that the elected licence is one of the offered terms, then judges the component by the elected licence only, and the NOTICE generator prints the election. Decision 383 (RM-17): a component offered under a choice of licences (an SPDX OR expression with more than one alternative) and no election is refused (NO ELECTION), shipped or build scope; a plain licence list is not a choice and is read as AND (every term must pass), RM-18. A class entry (purl_prefix plus offered, the exact set of single-licence alternatives) elects for every component of that prefix offering exactly that choice. The Jersey jars are elected one by one, each with the evidence of the texts its jar carries. A version change needs a new entry.

_comment_rust_crates: Decision 117: the Rust crates are MIT OR Apache-2.0; decision 383 elects Apache-2.0 for every crate offering exactly that choice (the class entry above). Any other choice of a crate is refused until it has an election. They matter only if a binary is ever shipped.
_comment_pending_review: Shipped components whose licence reading is open in the decision register. Each is reported as REVIEW REQUIRED and fails the gate until the register entry is closed and this list is updated (decision 117: the six Jersey jars stay unelected until their files are reviewed). Decision 176 (2026-11-12) closed DR-01 (the six Jersey jars, now elected EPL-2.0 above from the SPDX line of their own META-INF/NOTICE.md) and DR-02 (paranamer 2.8.3, BSD-3-Clause from the upstream LICENSE.txt at its release tag); evidence in the E16 CSV rows. The list is empty and stays in place for the next open reading.
_comment_reviewed_licences: Exact component versions whose package metadata names no licence: nothing at all, or a pointer to a file ('SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE'). 'licence' is the licence read from the package's own files and recorded for that version in decision-register.json (test_check_licences.py checks that the two agree); 'declared' is what the metadata said at the review (null = no licence member; a list when two tools spell the same metadata differently). The gate judges the component by 'licence' under the ordinary rules of this file, so an entry here accepts nothing by itself: LicenseRef-bpmn.io passes only through the LIC-8 conditional entry above, MIT because it is in 'allowed'. A different metadata value, or another version, fails (REVIEWED LICENCE MISMATCH, UNKNOWN LICENCE or NO LICENCE DATA) until the files are read again.

_comment_restricted: Copyleft licences allowed only through a conditional entry, an election or the OS-package rule; anywhere else they are forbidden, whatever the spelling (CF-17).
_comment_forbidden: Fails the build when found in what Sangam ships (runtime/compile scope SBOM, npm production deps).
_comment_os_packages: Owner decision 118 (C-03, 2026-11-12): operating-system packages in the base layers of a shipped image (purl types below, as syft reports them) are separate programs. GPL and LGPL licences are allowed for them, provided the image keeps their copyright files and ships the source offer named here. AGPL and every other forbidden licence stay forbidden, even for an OS package. Applies only to image SBOMs (distribution kind image).

_comment_build_time_tools: Owner decision 2026-11-12 (Wave 1, download batch 1): these LGPL tools are ALLOWED as build-time tools only (static analysis, CI scanning). Exactly these four tools and the four LGPL artefacts they pull in (extension of the same decision, 2026-11-12), at exactly these versions; any other version is re-approved and re-listed. They must never enter a shipped runtime classpath, image or SBOM: forbidden_components (SBOM), forbidden_jar_entries (fat jar), the root pom enforcer rule (shipped Maven scopes, ReactorBannedDependenciesTest) and .github/scripts/build_tools_not_shipped.py (SBOMs, fat jars and image SBOMs in CI) enforce that.
_comment_build_tool_exceptions: Owner decision 127 (C-12, 2026-11-12): build-tool exception for exactly these GPL+CPE and unproven-licence build artifacts at exactly these versions (decision register DR-04, DR-05, DR-06). Never shipped: the shipped-SBOM gates (forbidden in shipped scope via restricted/unknown), build_tools_not_shipped.py (CR-16) and the build/test SBOM review (check_licences.py --build-scope, CR-17). In build scope an unknown licence is reported, not failed; a forbidden licence or a forbidden component outside its scope still fails.
